import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# === Data (gen0 - gen7) ===
uncurated = {
    42:  [37.10, 44.89, 51.32, 56.25, 55.88, 50.08, 48.25, 50.28],
    123: [36.69, 45.29, 53.76, 53.76, 54.33, 53.00, 49.87, 46.15],
    456: [36.64, 45.03, 52.06, 52.55, 51.55, 49.40, 45.74, 44.69],
}

external = {
    42:  [37.04, 44.29, 50.12, 53.55, 52.27, 47.37, 46.11, 45.51],
    123: [36.66, 44.75, 52.21, 58.40, 54.89, 51.71, 49.17, 49.66],
}

rgds = {
    42:  [37.09, 45.36, 50.51, 53.82, 53.97, 61.75, 64.12, 75.07],
    123: [36.71, 42.81, 47.35, 52.64, 52.74, 60.62, 75.03, 81.57],
}

random50 = {
    42:  [36.87, 44.34, 49.75, 49.00, 50.85, 47.31, 44.78, 43.20],
    123: [36.46, 43.44, 49.59, 50.31, 47.64, 46.96, 41.05, 41.75],
    456: [36.91, 43.89, 46.22, 48.08, 45.26, 44.79, 45.63, 44.60],
}

gens = np.arange(8)

def stats(data_dict):
    arr = np.array(list(data_dict.values()))
    return arr.mean(axis=0), arr.std(axis=0), arr.min(axis=0), arr.max(axis=0), len(data_dict)

# === Plot ===
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.linewidth': 1.0,
    'xtick.direction': 'in',
    'ytick.direction': 'in',
    'xtick.major.size': 5,
    'ytick.major.size': 5,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))

configs = [
    (rgds,     'RGDS',            '#d62728', 'o', '-'),
    (external, 'External Only',   '#1f77b4', 's', '-'),
    (uncurated,'Uncurated',       '#555555', 'D', '-'),
    (random50, 'Random 50%',      '#2ca02c', '^', '-'),
]

for data, name, color, marker, ls in configs:
    mean, std, mn, mx, n = stats(data)
    label = f'{name} (n={n})'
    ax.plot(gens, mean, color=color, marker=marker, markersize=7, linewidth=2,
            linestyle=ls, label=label, zorder=3)
    if n >= 3:
        ax.fill_between(gens, mean - std, mean + std, color=color, alpha=0.15, zorder=1)
    else:
        ax.fill_between(gens, mn, mx, color=color, alpha=0.12, zorder=1)

ax.set_xlabel('Generation', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Perplexity (↓)', fontsize=14)
ax.set_xticks(gens)
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 7.2)
ax.set_ylim(33, 88)
ax.legend(frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor='#cccccc', fontsize=11, loc='upper left')
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/root/div_cal_verify/figures/fig1_ppl_trends.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.savefig('/root/div_cal_verify/figures/fig1_ppl_trends.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
print('Saved fig1_ppl_trends.pdf and fig1_ppl_trends.png')
PYEOF
